data.disagreement_analysis: The disagreement was caused by tool failures, not security concerns. The qwen model encountered HTTP 400 errors when reviewing the .desktop and .install files, while the openrouter model (advisory) had a parsing error on the PKGBUILD. The deepseek model successfully reviewed all files and found them safe. The inconclusive verdicts were artifacts of API/parsing failures rather than actual security ambiguity.

openrouter model failed to parse PKGBUILD decision, resulting in inconclusive status
learnings: Tool errors (API failures, parsing errors) should not override successful reviews from other models when the successful review covers all files
